resolvedStack: Electron + Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: CryoLab Telemetry Studio
description: CryoLab Telemetry Studio is a native Electron desktop workstation for laboratory cryogenics monitoring, sensor stream diagnostics, and automated calibration alerts backed by Next.js renderer workspace and Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: CryoLab Telemetry Studio
metadata.description: Native Electron desktop telemetry studio for lab instruments and calibration alerts.

files.description: Electron, Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, Zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
Electron main process creating BrowserWindow with preload.js and loading local Next.js server.
Electron contextBridge exposing safe IPC channels to renderer.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, SensorStatus, AlertSeverity enums and User, SensorNode, TelemetryReading, CalibrationAlert models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for SensorNode, TelemetryReading, CalibrationAlert.
Tailwind CSS base styles for desktop lab console.
Root layout wrapping SessionProvider, Navbar, main content, and Footer.
Desktop welcome landing page for CryoLab Telemetry Studio with launch CTA to /dashboard.
Desktop Command Center switching between TelemetryMonitor, CalibrationAlerts, and LabSettings renderer modules.
Client renderer component showing live cryogenic sensor nodes fetched from /api/sensors.
Client renderer component listing calibration alerts from /api/alerts with severity badges.
Client renderer component for lab sampling interval and threshold configuration.
Client hook fetching /api/sensors on mount via useEffect with safe array fallback.
GET and POST API route for SensorNode records with Zod and Prisma.
GET and POST API route for CalibrationAlert records with Zod and Prisma.
